_comment: With the widening limit at 8, small sets of key-shaped values are widened to the opaque boundary. Keys reach their lookups through widened variables: an object whose key property is written after it was widened, the same written through the widened element, a function given a key property late, and a hand-made key a service is provided under. Each lookup reaches its service's implementation, so each read method stays and the bundle runs.
